title: Unoverse object
description: <name>.yaml: the envelope of an object, as a node's node.yaml (docs/unoverse/data/objects/README.md 4a). What this is and when an Agent reaches for it, the row keys, and the props by $include. No credentials, no hosts, no lifecycle: a node is the only way an object touches the world (4b).

name.description: The object type, as a row's object_type names it. Equals the folder and the file.

icon.description: The glyph every row of this object is drawn with: a lucide icon name (file-text). The base's when unsaid.

element.description: Which of the twelve elements of the vocabulary this object IS (docs/unoverse/data/objects/README.md, the table of kinds and elements): a classification, never a shape. The Spatial view's filters and the search toggles read it. Not inherited; the need declares none.

extends.description: The object whose fields this one carries under its own. Every positioned object extends need, the atom (README 5).

uniqueBy.description: Which fields make two rows the same one: one key (a list of fields), or several keys tried in order (a list of lists). Absent on an object that is never a row.

embed.description: The fields whose text makes the vector. Absent on an object that is never a row (README 7).

search.description: What a search hit carries, universal_id first; the rest comes with getDetail.

storedAs.description: The stored object_type when it differs from the name (interface rows are stored as mcp). One word.

app.description: The interface every row wears, stamped at save: unoverse://components/<org>/<name>, the hash naming the state it opens in (State Model 5.3).

meta.description: Anything else a writer puts in metadata rides along, undeclared.

description.description: What this object is and how it is written, the brief the one model call reads. May name the org's identity: {{ identity.<document>.<field> }}.

whenToUse.description: When an Agent reaches for this object, in the customer's words.

props.description: The object's own props: { $include: props } for props.yaml beside this file, or the record inline.

links.description: The lines this object draws between its own rows, by name (docs/unoverse/data/objects/relationships-and-labels.md): rows of one folder whose `between` fields are equal are ordered by `order`, and each draws the line to the one just before it when `when` holds.

alike.description: Fields of between whose values may name one thing several ways; one model question per folder says which are the same.

to.description: A line to another object: the object it points at, by name.

match.description: One pair: this row's field naming that row's ({ manager: legalName }).

dataset.description: THE TABLE THIS OBJECT OWNS (docs/unoverse/data/objects/dataset.md): { $include: dataset } for dataset.yaml beside this file, or the declaration inline. Absent on every ordinary object, which is a row and not a dataset.

allOf.description: An object is a row and declares its props. An object that owns a table may be that table alone (dataset.md, ruled 2026-09-18): its rows are the table's, never the map's, so it declares no props.
